feature: Actual Simple360 Xenon H264 chroma/qpel port and scheduling parity
user_evidence: Same H264 still plays better in Simple360Player than Blades0.42; no fresh console measurement of0.43 yet

changes.DSP: Actual shift/add/6-tap code ported with GCC intrinsics and split context/const-stride ABI. Native scalar self-tests must pass before table installation.8-bit chroma8/4 and qpel16/8, small/high-depth scalar fallback.
changes.workers: H264 four FRAME workers3,4,5,2 at priority+1. Demux1, feeding2, audio1. Preserve slice fallback for codecs without FRAME capability.
changes.buffering: Four slots,3-ready audio preroll with2s bound, first-image and audio-lead protection retained.5ms due tolerance.
changes.catchup: 40ms skip nonref deblocking;250ms skip nonref frames; retain level until on time. Over500ms late output may drop but actual-take timestamp permits frame at least every500ms.
changes.diagnostics: DSP verdict at decoder open and first actual frame, placement, catchup/catchup_episodes and existing FPS/lag diagnostics
changes.GPU: Renderer/shader/colour sources byte-identical to0.42. CPU compressed-video decode, three linear GPU Y/U/V colour conversion/scaling to720p. No transcoder.
changes.license: GPLv3 combined executable; original MIT/FFmpeg/artwork/font/SDK notices preserved, complete corresponding source and build scripts supplied
changes.boundaries: FFmpeg2.8.22/free xsdk retained instead of whole upstream XDK/0.7 binary; bounded queues, correct scalar vertical deblocking retained instead of upstream incomplete no-op hook. Full binary is not byte-identical.
